description: Defines a Flutter widget 'SettingsPage' that provides user interface for adjusting app settings such as durations, graphics, resetting the board, clearing history, and stopping sessions.

classes.name: SettingsPage
classes.description: A stateless widget that builds the settings screen for the Pomodoro app, allowing modifications to timers, graphics, and resetting/clearing app state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the settings page, including app bar, list tiles for various settings, and actions to reset state and display snack bars.
